Order:

The instant criminal petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C)/under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') has been filed by the Petitioner/Accused No.2, seeking quashment of the F.I.R.No.458 of 2020 dated 20.06.2020 on the file of the Nandyal Taluk (U) Police Station, Kurnool District, for the offences punishable under Section 498(A), 354(A), 376, 420 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
2.
Heard Sri P.Sravan Kumar Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Ms.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the respondents.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the F.I.R.No.458 of 2020 has been lodged with a malicious intention to settle their personal scores and harass them.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would further submit that the police are not concluding the investigation in FIR No.458 of 2020 of Nandyal Taluk (U) Police Station, Kurnool District, till this day.
He would further submit that let there be a direction to the police for concluding the investigation as expeditiously as possible.
4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home seeks time for getting instruction in this matter.
